title: Terminal Illness & End-of-Life Planning in Turkmenistan: 5-Step Official Checklist
titleEn: Terminal Illness & End-of-Life Planning in Turkmenistan: 5-Step Official Checklist
cardSummary: Official 5-step serious and terminal illness checklist for Turkmenistan: palliative care coordination, advance directives, powers of attorney, disability and caregiver support, and estate preparation.
introHtml: Because Turkmenistan restricts and limits public online access to domestic government websites, healthcare portals, civil registry instructions, and official legal gazettes, this guide relies on verified international statutory archives (WIPO Lex, FAOLEX, CIS Legislation, and HCCH) alongside public international policy records [1] [2] [5] [7]. We outline five administrative steps to coordinate medical care, notarized powers of attorney, disability and pension entitlements, and advance succession records while the ill family member retains legal capacity [1] [4] [5].

steps.title: Organize healthcare delivery and medical documentation
steps.html:
• Navigate primary health centers and specialist hospitals: Under the Law of Turkmenistan on the Protection of Citizens Health (adopted May 23, 2015, and subsequent amendments), medical care is organized through territorial health clinics and specialized medical centers supervised by Public Health and Medical Care Authorities [5] [6] [9].
  • Verify mandatory or voluntary medical insurance coverage: Confirm the patient's state medical insurance booklet, outpatient clinical card, and specialist referral records so pain-management prescriptions and inpatient care remain uninterrupted [5] [9].
  • Discuss treatment consent and family communication: Confirm with attending doctors how clinical updates and treatment consent records are maintained, as standalone living-will registries do not operate online in Turkmenistan [5] [6].

steps.title: Execute a Power of Attorney at a State Notary Office
steps.html:
• Grant written authority while the patient has capacity: Under Article 128 of the Civil Code of Turkmenistan (together with updated Civil Code provisions recorded through 2025), legal representation arises from law or a written Power of Attorney, and financial, property, or state filings require certification by State Notary Offices [1] [2] [3].
  • Address incapacity and guardianship rules: Under Articles 31 to 33 of the Civil Code, if a person becomes legally incapable without an active Power of Attorney, a court must formally establish guardianship (opeka) or trusteeship before an authorized person can sign legal transactions on their behalf [1].
  • Arrange home notarial visits if bedbound: Contact local State Notary Offices directly to inquire about home or hospital notarization when mobility prevents office attendance [1] [3].

steps.title: Apply for disability classification and social protection benefits
steps.html:
• Obtain medical-social expert evaluation: Under the Code of Turkmenistan on Social Protection of the Population (Law No. 340-IV of October 19, 2012, as amended through 2024), Social Protection and Pension Authorities of Turkmenistan administer disability pensions, state allowances, and social assistance based on medical-social disability assessments [4] [9].
  • Verify pension bank routing and verification rules: Ensure pension and disability allowance accounts with state banks are active and check periodic in-person or representative verification schedules required by local pension offices [4] [9].
  • Maintain current civil and tax identifiers: Confirm that national passports, household registration books, and pension booklets match without spelling discrepancies across Turkmen and Russian scripts [4] [8].

steps.title: Prepare a will and plan for non-Apostille document authentication
steps.html:
• Execute a written will: Under Articles 1106 to 1120 of the Civil Code of Turkmenistan, an adult with legal capacity may execute a written will (certified at State Notary Offices, or by an archyn where no notary operates; spouses may also prepare a joint will under Article 1106) [1].
  • Check consular legalization requirements for foreign use: Per the HCCH status table, Turkmenistan is not a Contracting Party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention [7]. Any Turkmen Power of Attorney, medical record, or will that must be relied upon abroad requires diplomatic consular legalization through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan and the relevant foreign embassy [7] [8].
  • Reverse cross-border check: Likewise, powers of attorney signed outside Turkmenistan for use inside the country must go through full consular legalization and certified Turkmen or Russian translation [7] [8].

steps.title: Assemble property, bank, and insurance records
steps.html:
• Consolidate ownership documentation: Keep residential property deeds, bank passbooks, pension certificates, and birth or marriage certificates in one accessible folder [1] [4].
  • Clarify obligations early: Under Article 1089 of the Civil Code, estates transfer both property rights and attached financial obligations at succession, so documenting bank loans, utility accounts, and workplace benefit contacts early helps family caregivers [1] [2].

closingQuestion: Are you coordinating inpatient care or home-based arrangements inside Turkmenistan, and will any powers of attorney need consular legalization from abroad?

prefillQuestion: A family member is facing a serious or terminal illness in Turkmenistan. We need an overview of the main official steps and contacts in Turkmenistan for palliative care, powers of attorney, advance directives, and caregiver support.

contacts.name: State Notary Offices
contacts.note: Local state notary offices certify powers of attorney, wills, and official translations under Civil Code and notarial rules (no public online directory is available abroad).

contacts.name: Social Protection and Pension Authorities of Turkmenistan
contacts.note: Administer state pension accounts, disability allowances, and social protection benefits under the Code on Social Protection of the Population.

contacts.name: Public Health and Medical Care Authorities
contacts.note: Coordinate territorial health clinics, specialist centers, and medical-social disability referrals under the Law on Protection of Citizens Health.

contacts.name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan
contacts.note: Handles diplomatic consular legalization for Turkmen documents sent abroad and incoming foreign documents (non-Apostille state).
